<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 193.1103, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈192.103 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈12 % M+1 intensity) suggests about 11–12 carbons. A formula that matches the exact mass and isotopic pattern is C₁₂H₁₆O₂ (exact monoisotopic mass 192.1150 Da, within typical instrument tolerance). No additional heteroatoms are indicated. Therefore the molecular formula is: C12H16O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O2</final_answer>
